criteria.name: intent_correctness
criteria.definition: Exact match between gold intent and validated JSON intent
criteria.aggregation: accuracy on schema-valid rows; invalid JSON counts as incorrect for the pipeline

criteria.name: schema_validity
criteria.definition: Bare JSON object passes extract_json_object + contract checks

criteria.name: response_safety_relevance
criteria.definition: Manual score 1-5 relevance plus binary pass if no credentials solicited and no fake bank action claimed

criteria.name: tool_call_correctness
criteria.definition: Allowlisted tool only; arguments match schema; no tool invocation when JSON invalid

criteria.name: latency_tokens
criteria.definition: Wall-clock seconds and input/output token counts

reporting_rules: Never merge C1-C4 into a single unsupported accuracy claim
State exact n and whether split is development or reserved test
Do not tune prompts on official_test_pilot
E1 n=3 is observational only; general_accuracy_claim must remain false
